pr_comments: Not much non-anonymous left I think? :eyes:

@ritchie46 Yes, There are only very few left. I have checked, and it falls into two categories:
1. Depending on user defined functions, for example: `fold_expr/reduce_exprs/cum_reduce_exprs/cum_fold_exprs`.
2. It's not as simple as the other functions to get the output dtype. for example: `list.to_struct/list.eval`. `list.to_struct` assigns a `rwLock` first and then accesses this lock in `GetOutput::map_dtype`. https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/blob/45e4ce89393731ce826c176d90a1eba42c26ee34/crates/polars-plan/src/dsl/list.rs#L258


As for the first one, IIUC, `UDF` should not be able to non-anonymous 🤔. As for the second, do you have any thoughts?

issue_context.title: Panic when using `duration` with `LazyFrame` created from `LazyCsvReader`
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://crates.io/crates/polars) of Polars.


### Reproducible example

`main.rs`:
```rust
use polars::prelude::*;

fn is_distant_past(date_col: Expr, days_past: u32) -> Expr {
    let date = date_col.str().strptime(
        DataType::Date,
        StrptimeOptions {
            format: Some("%Y-%m-%d".into()),
            strict: true,
            exact: false,
            cache: true,
        },
        lit("raise"),
    );
    let offset = duration(DurationArgs {
        days: lit(days_past),
        ..Default::default()
    });
    let today = lit(chrono::offset::Utc::now().naive_local().date());

    (date + offset).lt_eq(today)
}

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let df = LazyCsvReader::new("./test.csv")
        .finish()?
        .filter(is_distant_past(col("date"), 5));

    println!("{:?}", df.collect()?);

    Ok(())
}
```

`test.csv`:
```csv
date
2024-01-01
2024-01-05
2024-01-10
```

### Issue description

Clearly this has to do with `impl Hash for Expr`. A branch that should not be reached (in debug mode, anyway) is in fact reached.

https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/blob/67507fffbff54679a4ff0e11f602b41e3ad6b99f/crates/polars-plan/src/dsl/expr.rs#L169

https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/blob/67507fffbff54679a4ff0e11f602b41e3ad6b99f/crates/polars-plan/src/dsl/expr.rs#L228-L233

When replacing the `todo!()` line above with `todo!("IMPLEMENT {self:?}")`, what is printed is `not yet implemented: IMPLEMENT 0.duration([5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0])`. I believe this means that the `expr` that was hashed was the `Function` created from `duration(DurationArgs { days: lit(5), ..Default::default() })`.

https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/blob/67507fffbff54679a4ff0e11f602b41e3ad6b99f/crates/polars-plan/src/logical_plan/format.rs#L360-L368

If I replace the `LazyCsvReader` with a regular `CsvReader` or an in-memory DataFrame created with `df!` (followed by `.lazy()` before the `filter`), this issue goes away. So I feel pretty confident in saying that it's somehow related to `LazyCsvReader` leading to a `Expr::Function` being hashed.

### Expected behavior

No panic. The results from above would be:

```rust
shape: (1, 1)
┌────────────┐
│ date       │
│ ---        │
│ str        │
╞════════════╡
│ 2024-01-01 │
└────────────┘
```

### Installed versions

Polars:
```toml
polars = { version = "0.36.2", features = [
	"csv",
	"lazy",
	"strings",
	"temporal",
] }
```

Rust:
```sh
$ rustc --version
rustc 1.75.0 (82e1608df 2023-12-21)
```
comments: Interested in making a PR for this one?
Aside from removing that `todo!()` is there anything else that should happen? Is there supposed to be a better implementation for the wildcard branch than stringification?

I'm not sure if we can implement a good hash function for anonymous functions, maybe @ritchie46  has some ideas. But as for this issue itself, I think we can make `pl.duration` non-anonymous. PR is coming.
Is it correct that that PR solves this issue specifically for `duration` but not for other anonymous functions?

> Is it correct that that PR solves this issue specifically for duration but not for other anonymous functions?

Yes, this is why I marked this PR as `refactor` instead of `fix`. But this error only appears in debug release and is in some sense intentional, so I'm fine with keeping or removing the `todo!`. Also, we're working on making as many functions as possible non-anonymous, but it's going to take some time. :)

review_comments: By convention (leftmost rule), we shouldn't give expression name(`duration` at this case). So I remove this `alias`.
